shadow_daggers.name: Obsidian Daggers
shadow_daggers.desc: +16 Attack Power, +25% Attack Speed, +0.5 Speed [💀 Dark Element].

sweeping_claymore.name: Sweeping Claymore
sweeping_claymore.desc: +18 Attack Power, +55% Sweeping Edge, +10% Attack Speed [🌿 Earth Element].

inferno_blade.name: Inferno Edge
inferno_blade.desc: +20 Attack Power, +35% Swipe [🔥 Fire Element]. Scorches foes with blistering heat.

glacial_spire.name: Glacial Spire
glacial_spire.desc: +21 Attack Power, +35 Max Mana [❄️ Ice Element]. Freezes monsters upon strike.

storm_breaker.name: Storm Breaker
storm_breaker.desc: +26 Attack Power, +22% Attack Speed, +40% Swipe [⚡ Lightning Element].

wind_rapier.name: Zephyr Swiftblade
wind_rapier.desc: +22 Attack Power, +35% Attack Speed, +25% Swipe [⚡ Wind/Lightning Element].

archmage_staff.name: Archmage Staff
archmage_staff.desc: +24 Attack Power, +40 Max Mana, +10% Attack Speed [🔥 Arcane Fire Element].

excalibur.name: Radiant Holy Blade
excalibur.desc: +35 Attack Power, +45% Swipe, +20% Attack Speed, +50 Max Health [✨ Holy Element]. Annihilates dark creatures.

woodsman_axe.name: Woodsman Axe
woodsman_axe.desc: +12 Attack Power, +40% Swipe, [Earth Element]. A heavy logging axe that bites deep.

iron_morningstar.name: Iron Morningstar
iron_morningstar.desc: +14 Attack Power, +2 Defense, [Neutral Element]. Spiked iron that cracks armor.

hunter_spear.name: Hunter's Spear
hunter_spear.desc: +13 Attack Power, +10% Attack Speed, [Neutral Element]. Long reach, quick jabs.

frostbite_katana.name: Frostbite Katana
frostbite_katana.desc: +22 Attack Power, +20% Attack Speed, [Ice Element]. Its edge never thaws.

venom_kris.name: Venom Fang Kris
venom_kris.desc: +18 Attack Power, +30% Attack Speed, [Earth Element]. A wavy blade dripping with toxin.

voidcaller_wand.name: Voidcaller Wand
voidcaller_wand.desc: +19 Attack Power, +50 Max Mana, [Dark Element]. Whispers from the abyss guide each bolt.

ember_scythe.name: Ember Reaper Scythe
ember_scythe.desc: +28 Attack Power, +60% Swipe, [Fire Element]. Harvests souls in sweeping arcs of flame.

thunder_maul.name: Thunder Maul
thunder_maul.desc: +32 Attack Power, +35% Swipe, [Lightning Element]. Every blow rolls like a storm.

dawn_scepter.name: Scepter of Dawn
dawn_scepter.desc: +34 Attack Power, +60 Max Mana, +40 Max Health, [Holy Element]. Radiates the first light of morning.

dragonbone_glaive.name: Dragonbone Glaive
dragonbone_glaive.desc: +38 Attack Power, +55% Swipe, [Fire Element]. Carved from the spine of an elder wyrm.

riftwalker_edge.name: Riftwalker's Edge
riftwalker_edge.desc: +46 Attack Power, +12% Attack Speed, +40 Max Mana [💀 Dark Element]. Any class can wield it. [Right Click] Rift Step: teleport 3 tiles ahead and explode, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles. 0.25s cooldown, drains a little MP.

nightfall_twinblades.name: Nightfall Twinblades
nightfall_twinblades.desc: +54 Attack Power, +18% Attack Speed, +0.4 Speed [💀 Dark Element]. [Right Click] Eternal Alpha: blink between the 5 nearest enemies, striking each one, untouchable while it lasts.

gatekeeper_greatsword.name: Gatekeeper's Greatsword
gatekeeper_greatsword.desc: +60 Attack Power, +250 Max Health, +60% Swipe [✨ Holy Element]. No right-click ability. Endless Sweep: your cleave reaches 2.5 tiles further across a 220° arc, but all your damage is reduced by 30%.

sunfire_conduit.name: Sunfire Conduit
sunfire_conduit.desc: +52 Attack Power, +120 Max Mana, +8% Attack Speed [🔥 Fire Element]. Sunfire Channel: your basic attack channels a fireball into each of the 5 nearest enemies instead of one splashing bolt, and your magic damage is increased by 10%.
